children: , a solutions firm that specializes in technology and other professional staffing services, today announced that management will participate in the J.P. Morgan Ultimate Services Investor Conference in New York on November 17.

Kforce Inc. is a solutions firm specializing in technology, finance and accounting, and other professional staffing services. It claims its KNOWLEDGEforce® empowers industry-leading companies to achieve their digital transformation goals.

The company claims to curate teams of technical experts who deliver solutions custom-tailored to each client’s needs. These scalable, flexible outcomes are shaped by deep market knowledge, thought leadership and its multi-industry expertise.

“Our integrated approach,” reads today’s news release, “is rooted in over 60 years of proven success deploying highly skilled professionals on a temporary and direct-hire basis. Each year, approximately 17,000 talented experts work with Fortune 500 and other leading companies. Together, we deliver Great Results Through Strategic Partnership and Knowledge Sharing.”

title: KForce to Speak at November Conference
